import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

root=Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-seed1-sft-validation-v1')
core=(root/'evaluate_core.py').read_text()
commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
core=core.replace('SOURCE_COMMIT = "75888b53519ceddc0dc804f06ef9d978ba966e02"',f'SOURCE_COMMIT = "{commit}"')
old='        evaluate(model, tokenizer, args)\n        return'
assert core.count(old)==1
core=core.replace(old,'        profile_dtype(model, tokenizer, args)\n        return')
function=Path('runs/qwen38_dtype_probe_function.txt').read_text()
core=core.replace('if __name__ == "__main__":',function+'\nif __name__ == "__main__":')
folder=Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_dtype_probe');folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
flags=['--eval-only','--model','unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-unsloth-bnb-4bit','--base-model','Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B',
       '--revision','8aa5f05d26b7205477066e1449e0af13f762a299','--device-map','unsloth_balanced',
       '--lora-rank','8','--seed','0','--budget-seconds','2700','--label','qwen3.8-27b-dtype-profile']
source=f'''import subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
core=Path('/kaggle/working/dtype_core.py')
core.write_text({core!r})
adapters=list(Path('/kaggle/input').rglob('warmstart_adapter/adapter_config.json'))
assert len(adapters)==1, adapters
subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(core),*{flags!r},'--adapter',str(adapters[0].parent)],check=True)
'''
(folder/'grpo_unsloth_kaggle.py').write_text(source)
metadata=json.loads(Path('runs/kaggle_qwen38_primary_sft_validate/kernel-metadata.json').read_text())
metadata.update(id='nicolascoquelet/makemarketbench-qwen3-8-27b-dtype-probe',title='MakeMarketBench Qwen3 8 27B dtype probe')
(folder/'kernel-metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata,indent=2)+'\n')
plan={'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'diagnose slow T4 BF16 inference on training states only'},'8aa5f05d26b7205477066e1449e0af13f762a299'),
      'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'profile_function':function,'metadata':metadata,'source_sha256':file_sha256(folder/'grpo_unsloth_kaggle.py'),
      'original_core_sha256':file_sha256(root/'evaluate_core.py'),'adapter_sha256':file_sha256(Path('results/kaggle/qwen38-round3-training-v5/warmstart_adapter/adapter_model.safetensors')),
      'hypothesis':'Convert residual BF16 floating parameters/buffers and BF16 bitsandbytes compute to FP32; avoid emulated BF16 on T4 without changing saved adapter weights. Measure speed, memory, valid quotes and exact quote agreement before any promotion.',
      'status':'registered_before_profile','session_timeout_seconds':3000,'script_cap_seconds':2700,
      'promotion':'No speedup or policy identity is assumed. If adopted, validate the precision variant on both games before selection and conservatively increase the final family before opening held-out aggregates.',
      'upstream_context':['https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth/issues/4970','https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unslothai/unsloth/main/unsloth/models/loader.py']}
path=Path('results/training/qwen38_dtype_probe_plan.json');assert not path.exists();path.write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Prepared private training-state dtype probe')
